Create one standalone logo proposal screen for the personal brand “Jovina Diniz”.

This screen must contain ONLY one logo concept for review, not a website, not a moodboard, not a complete visual identity presentation.

**LOGO DIRECTION:** Authorial signature.
Develop “Jovina Diniz” as an elegant, memorable signature-style logo with controlled expressive strokes and premium professional presence. It must feel sophisticated and intentional rather than casual handwriting. Include the descriptor “Terapeuta Integrativa & Mentora de Mulheres” in a quiet supporting line.

**PRESENTATION:** One dominant signature logo and one compact secondary lockup. Label the screen “Opção 02”.

No generic therapy/wellness icons and none of these motifs: lotus, butterfly, brain, heart outline, hands, female silhouette, tree, moon, mandala, leaf, infinity symbol, medical cross.
